name: Motörhead

whyMatters.en: Lemmy’s power trio between punk tempo and metal volume. Ace of Spades (1980) fixed speed and attitude as a shared reference for both scenes.
whyMatters.zh: Lemmy 的三件套：介于朋克速度与金属音量之间。Ace of Spades（1980）成为朋克与金属两边场景的共同速度参照。

lyricQuotes: The pleasure is to play, makes no difference what you say
Born to lose / Live to win

shortBio.en: UK speed/heavy rock; Ace of Spades is the three-chord velocity reference.
shortBio.zh: 英国速度/重型摇滚；Ace of Spades 是三和弦速度参照。

body.en:
Formed in 1975 after Lemmy left Hawkwind. Overkill, Ace of Spades, and No Sleep 'til Hammersmith document the classic Lemmy / Eddie Clarke / Phil Taylor attack—bass played like rhythm guitar, shouted vocal, 4/4 charge.

Ace of Spades (1980) is the citation track when thrash and hardcore bands name Motörhead as a tempo ancestor. The craft is relentlessness and midrange grit in the mix, not progressive form.

Lemmy had played R&B and psychedelic groups, road-managed Jimi Hendrix, then joined Hawkwind. Hawkwind fired him after a 1975 North American drug bust. He named the new band after his last Hawkwind song, Motörhead (an amphetamine user); he had first wanted the name Bastard. Larry Wallis and Lucas Fox were brief. The set lineup was Lemmy, “Fast” Eddie Clarke, and Phil “Philthy Animal” Taylor: Overkill (1979), Ace of Spades (1980), and the UK #1 live album No Sleep ’til Hammersmith (1981). Clarke and Taylor were gone by 1982. Brian Robertson (Thin Lizzy) and Pete Gill (ex-Saxon) came in; Robertson left in 1983 over stage clothes and a refusal to play old songs. Phil Campbell (ex-Persian Risk) and Michael “Würzel” Burston, who got in by sending Lemmy a cassette, replaced him. Taylor returned for Rock ’n’ Roll (1987), which includes a Michael Palin cameo. Mikkey Dee is on Bastards (1993). From 1995 the band was a trio after Würzel left (he died in 2011). Inferno (2004) has Steve Vai as a guest; Kiss of Death (2006) has C.C. DeVille (Poison) and Mike Inez (Alice in Chains). Motörizer (2008) and The Wörld Is Yours (2010) were the first albums in the entry to reach the Billboard top 100, more than 30 years after the start.
body.zh:
Lemmy 离开 Hawkwind 后于 1975 年组建。Overkill、Ace of Spades 与 No Sleep 'til Hammersmith 记录经典 Lemmy / Eddie Clarke / Phil Taylor 攻击——贝斯按节奏吉他弹、喊叫人声、4/4 冲锋。

Ace of Spades（1980）是 thrash 与 hardcore 乐队点名 Motörhead 为速度祖先时的引用曲。工艺在于不停歇与混音中频砂感，而非 progressive 曲式。

Lemmy 在 R&B 与迷幻乐队待过，给 Jimi Hendrix 当过巡演经理，然后加入 Hawkwind。1975 年北美一次缉毒后 Hawkwind 把他开除。新乐队用他为 Hawkwind 写的最后一首歌命名：Motörhead（指服用安非他命的人）；他原本想叫 Bastard。Larry Wallis 与 Lucas Fox 时间很短。固定阵容是 Lemmy、“Fast” Eddie Clarke 与 Phil “Philthy Animal” Taylor：Overkill（1979）、Ace of Spades（1980），以及英国榜首现场专辑 No Sleep ’til Hammersmith（1981）。到 1982 年 Clarke 与 Taylor 都离开。Brian Robertson（Thin Lizzy）与 Pete Gill（前 Saxon）加入；1983 年 Robertson 因舞台装扮和不愿演奏老歌离队。Phil Campbell（前 Persian Risk）与给 Lemmy 寄盒带入选的 Michael “Würzel” Burston 接替。Taylor 为 Rock ’n’ Roll（1987）回归，其中有 Michael Palin 客串。Mikkey Dee 打 Bastards（1993）。1995 年起 Würzel 离队，乐队成为三人（他 2011 年去世）。Inferno（2004）有 Steve Vai 客席；Kiss of Death（2006）有 C.C. DeVille（Poison）与 Mike Inez（Alice in Chains）。Motörizer（2008）与 The Wörld Is Yours（2010）是条目中成立 30 多年后第一次进入公告牌专辑前 100 的唱片。

note.en: Double-kick opener—tempo as identity before thrash codified.
note.zh: 双踩开场——thrash 定形前的速度身份。

note.en: Three-chord velocity reference—Lemmy bass as rhythm guitar in the mix.
note.zh: 三和弦速度参照——混音中 Lemmy 贝斯当节奏吉他。

note.zh: 警笛 intro 与中速 stomp；舞台轰炸机装置作视觉制作。

title.zh: 离开 Hawkwind 组建 Motörhead

body.en:
Lemmy forms Bastard, renamed Motörhead after a Hawkwind song. Debut and Overkill (1979) establish the power trio: Lemmy's Rickenbacker bass through Marshall, Clarke's blues-rock guitar, Taylor's double-kick.

No fancy solos—song length stays under four minutes. Punk clubs and metal audiences both claim the band.

Lemmy's vocal is shouted conversation, not operatic metal.
body.zh:
Lemmy 组建 Bastard，后改 Motörhead，名出 Hawkwind 曲。首张与 Overkill（1979）定 power trio：Lemmy Rickenbacker 贝斯进 Marshall、Clarke blues-rock 吉他、Taylor 双踩。

无花哨 solo——曲长压四分钟内。朋克俱乐部与金属听众都认这支乐队。

Lemmy 人声是喊叫式对话，非歌剧金属。

body.en:
Ace of Spades (1980) title track opens on Lemmy's bass riff—E minor gallop at about 140 BPM. Clarke's guitar doubles the root; no keyboard pad.

The album mixes fast cuts (Ace of Spades, Shoot You in the Back) and slower ones (Live to Win, Leave Me Alone)—dynamic range inside speed metal.

No Sleep 'til Hammersmith (1981) becomes the live performance reference.
body.zh:
Ace of Spades（1980）标题曲以 Lemmy 贝斯 riff 开场——E 小调 gallop 约 140 BPM。Clarke 吉他双根音；无键盘垫。

专辑混快曲（Ace of Spades、Shoot You in the Back）与慢曲（Live to Win、Leave Me Alone）——速度金属内的动态幅度。

No Sleep 'til Hammersmith（1981）成现场演出参照。

alt.en: Lemmy Kilmister with Motörhead, St Albans, 1982
alt.zh: Lemmy Kilmister 与 Motörhead，圣奥尔本斯，1982

title.zh: 阵容更替与 thrash 债务

body.en:
Clarke exits in 1982; Phil Campbell joins for a two-guitar era. Iron Fist and Killed by Death extend the speed approach.

Metallica, Slayer, and Anthrax cite Motörhead for tempo and attitude—not riff complexity.

Lemmy runs the band until his death in 2015; four decades of live reliability is a secondary legacy.
body.zh:
Clarke 1982 年离队；Phil Campbell 加入双吉他时期。Iron Fist 与 Killed by Death 延伸速度写法。

Metallica、Slayer、Anthrax 引 Motörhead 的速度与态度——非 riff 复杂度。

Lemmy 运营乐队至 2015 年去世；四十年现场可靠为次要遗产。

label.en: Classic three: Lemmy / Fast Eddie / Philthy
label.zh: 经典三人：Lemmy / Fast Eddie / Philthy

note.en: Clarke / Taylor trio through Hammersmith. Later book chairs: Robertson (Thin Lizzy), Gill (Saxon), Campbell, Würzel, then Dee. Trio again after Würzel left in 1995.
note.zh: Clarke / Taylor 三人组直到 Hammersmith。书中后来的座位：Robertson（Thin Lizzy）、Gill（Saxon）、Campbell、Würzel，然后 Dee。1995 年 Würzel 离队后再成三人。

note.en: Gambling riff and Lemmy bark as Motörhead’s permanent ID.
note.zh: 赌博 riff 与 Lemmy 吼叫，Motörhead 永久身份标识。

note.en: Bass as rhythm guitar; volume as the central stance.
note.zh: 贝斯当节奏吉他；音量是核心立场。
